name: B10-0215/2024 – § 1 – Am 6
title: PROPOSAL FOR A DECISION on setting up a standing committee on Security and Defence and a standing committee on Public Health
part_text: 1. Decides to set up a standing committee on Security and Defence and that the subcommittees on Security and Defence and Human Rights shall cease to exist; decides that the responsibilities of the committee on Foreign Affairs shall be amended accordingly;
